fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309362/rates (Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31: PeakSingleCampsite $12) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/upper-chattahoochee-river-campground ('Camping: $12/site/night'), read 2026-10-30

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/upper-chattahoochee-river-campground ('The Interagency Senior and Access Passes ... entitle the pass holder to a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservation only, online or at 877-444-6777, made before coming to the site. 14 nights in any 30 days on Chattahoochee-Oconee NF land, then leave the forest for 30 days. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 12:01 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309362 (notice 'All Camping is by Reservation only. There is NO First Come, First Serve ...'; 'Check out time is 12:01 pm and check in time starts at 2:00 pm'; rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', minConsecutiveStay 1 soft = no rule) + FS page ('The maximum stay is 14 day'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309362/campsites + RIDB catalog (all 19 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 19 sites, but recreation.gov permits no RV or motorhome type on any of them and caps trailers at 10 ft on 13 sites (site 1: 14 ft, site 12: 16 ft); sites 13-14 take pickup campers and pop-ups to 14 ft but no trailer; sites 9-11 are tent sites. Only sites 15 and 16 (parallel pull-offs, driveways 41 and 39 ft) permit a trailer with no length limit, so 2 is the count a 23-ft motorhome can book.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309362/campsites (permitted_equipment per site: 'Trailer:10' on sites 2-8, 17-19; 'Trailer:14' site 1; 'Trailer:16' site 12; 'Trailer' with no max_length on 15 and 16; sites 9-11 tent/car only) + RIDB catalog (Driveway Length 23-87 ft, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-30

values.note: No drinking water: the wells are being decommissioned, so bring all water. Portable toilets at the front of the campground until the new toilet buildings are in place.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309362 ('Drinking water will not be available at this campground. The well systems ... being decommissioned'; 'Until new toilet building(s) are in place, portable toilets located at the front of the campground') + FS alert of 2026-06-11 ('Drinking water is unavailable as system replacement work continues on the Upper Chattahoochee River Campground') + FS page ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-30

note: Chattahoochee NF campground at the headwaters of the Chattahoochee River, 5 miles up gravel Forest Service Road 44 (Upper Chattahoochee River Road) off GA-75 north of Helen. No ATVs, UTVs or golf carts on the campground or the road. --Claude
summary: FIT/DROP CANDIDATE: rec.gov lists no RV/motorhome type, and caps trailers at 10-16 ft on 15 of 19 sites; only sites 15-16 allow a trailer with no length, so count 19 -> 2. Confirmed $12 (2026-2027), reservation only (fcfs never), no hookups, no potable water (wells decommissioned, FS alert 2026-06-11), Senior/Access 50%; added 14-night max and rec.gov booking. Season left unset: FS 03/15-10/31 vs rec.gov selling Mar 16 - Dec 15. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: CRITERIA / FIT QUESTION (trailer limit under 23 ft): recreation.gov permits no RV or motorhome type on any site. Trailers: 10 ft on sites 2-8 and 17-19, 14 ft on site 1, 16 ft on site 12; none on 13-14 (pickup camper, pop-up to 14 ft); sites 9-11 tent/car only. Only sites 15 and 16 permit 'Trailer' with no length (parallel, RIDB driveways 41 and 39 ft). RIDB Driveway Length 23-87 ft on every site. The FS page gives no length. A posted trailer limit under 23 ft applies to EKKO (Chapman Reservoir precedent), so at most 2 of 19 sites; count set to 2.

Season disagreement: FS page 'Seasons of Use 03/15 - 10/31', but recreation.gov sells nights through 2026-12-15 (17 sites Available in November and early December; all Closed from 2026-12-16) and reopens 2027-03-16. Season left unset.

FS page wording 'Operational Hours: Upper Chattahoochee River Campground Temporarily Closed for Facility Improvements' contradicts its own 'Site Open' banner, the June 11, 2026 alert (water only) and recreation.gov (reservations taken and held through October 2026; November open). Not recorded as a closure; it looks like stale text from the restroom replacement.
Sites 10 and 11 are Closed on every November-December 2026 date on rec.gov (tent sites).

Access: FS page 'turn left onto the graveled Chattahoochee River Road and follow for 5 miles'; rec.gov 'Travel approximately 5 miles on the dirt road'. No 4WD, clearance or length wording; no FS road alert for FS-44 (alerts read 2026-10-30).
Phone 706-754-6221 confirmed (FS page, Chattooga River Ranger District). Pin 34.7893,-83.7834 is 91 m from the per-site centroid (34.79003,-83.78385): fine.
